{{PAGENAME}} is an ingredient used in [[cooking]] to create [[baked meat]].
The recipe to make Raw Sliced Meat from 3x Frogs is unlocked when you get a Frog via fishing (strangely, it is NOT unlocked when you get a Frog by purchasing it from Clotho the Witch).
